objective: Make one fresh, sanitized, terminal-only AGY quota observation for each isolated AGY alias without a model task or raw-output persistence.

authorization.approval_reference: Fresh Root A relay: user explicitly authorizes direct provider CLI call in terminal/tmux only for quota inspection as root-cause workaround.
authorization.transport_approval_reference: tmux first; direct terminal is fallback only for the quota command and only when tmux transport/session setup fails BEFORE any provider invocation starts. Once /usage has been invoked, no fallback/retry.
scope: agy1: at most one literal standalone agy -p /usage invocation in its account-specific inherited terminal environment
agy2: at most one literal standalone agy -p /usage invocation in its distinct account-specific inherited terminal environment
transport_order: Use a child-owned detached tmux PTY first.
A direct child-owned terminal is allowed only when tmux setup fails before any provider invocation starts and a safe pre-invocation failure classification is recorded.
After the provider invocation starts, no fallback, retry, or second transport is authorized.
prohibited: any provider command other than the exact literal agy -p /usage argument vector
model prompt, model task, tool task, or provider transaction
provider, account, authentication, runtime-config, or settings mutation
retry, fallback subprocess after invocation, or a second provider invocation
access to provider network, account, browser, authentication, or home contents by the preflight/sanitizer lane
raw stdout, stderr, provider stream, TUI pane, prior pane, email, token, key, cookie, credential, or account-home value persistence
capture-pane or inspection of stale/prior pane contents
retroactive validation, repair, replacement, or overwrite of attempts 1 through 4

account_scope.pool_isolation: Quota, invocation budget, lease, result, and failure state remain account-local and may not be aggregated, borrowed, or silently rerouted.
account_scope.account_binding: Each provider child inherits its alias-specific AGY_HOME inside its owned PTY. The value and home contents must not be printed, stored, compared, or inspected.

prior_attempt_boundary.attempt_4_agy1: May contain a valid time-bound binding, but attempt 5 is fresh and does not revalidate or reuse it.
prior_attempt_boundary.attempt_4_agy2: The unitless value 39 is unknown and ambiguous, is not quota evidence, and must not be converted to a fraction, percentage, band, concurrency, or capacity entitlement.
prior_attempt_boundary.preservation: Attempt 5 never retroactively validates, repairs, replaces, retries, or overwrites attempt 4 or earlier history.

agy1.rationale: A one-command observation is narrow, but secret/raw-output exposure, ambiguous quota units, and receipt binding are rank-3 fail-closed concerns. The selected profile is governance classification only; no provider model task is authorized.

agy2.rationale: A one-command observation is narrow, but secret/raw-output exposure, ambiguous quota units, and receipt binding are rank-3 fail-closed concerns. The selected profile is governance classification only; no provider model task is authorized.

agy1.objective: One pre-admission quota observation only; explicitly no provider model task.
agy1.exact_scope: literal agy -p /usage through the sanitizer boundary
agy1.expected_evidence: One allowlisted sanitizer JSON object or content-free typed failure metadata.
agy1.stop_state: Stop after the first invocation outcome, or before invocation on any preflight/lease/transport failure.

agy2.objective: One pre-admission quota observation only; explicitly no provider model task.
agy2.exact_scope: literal agy -p /usage through the sanitizer boundary
agy2.expected_evidence: One allowlisted sanitizer JSON object or content-free typed failure metadata.
agy2.stop_state: Stop after the first invocation outcome, or before invocation on any preflight/lease/transport failure.

agy1.admission_scope: pre-admission quota observation only; no provider model task
agy1.validation_rule: Fail closed when expired, consumed, mismatched, over budget, or not bound to the exact request/alias/owner. Do not renew silently.

agy2.admission_scope: pre-admission quota observation only; no provider model task
agy2.validation_rule: Fail closed when expired, consumed, mismatched, over budget, or not bound to the exact request/alias/owner. Do not renew silently.

sanitizer_boundary.execution_boundary: Direct in-memory subprocess sanitizer; no shell pipeline and no raw stdout/stderr persistence.
sanitizer_boundary.inherited_environment: Alias-specific AGY_HOME must already be present; its value is neither copied into the subprocess arguments nor printed or persisted.
sanitizer_boundary.bucket_metric_rule: Each unique bucket has label plus exactly one of remaining_fraction, remaining_percent, or safe_band, with at most one reset_time or reset_in_seconds.
sanitizer_boundary.safe_failure_rule: Unexpected fields, auth prompts, PII, paths, credential-like text, missing or duplicate buckets, unitless values, ANSI-obscured drift, malformed output, timeout, nonzero exit, decode failure, or ambiguity emits only content-free typed failure metadata with an empty buckets array; quota stays unknown.

receipt_binding_contract.sanitized_output_binding: Hash and byte-count the exact compact sanitizer JSON bytes only. Never hash, retain, copy, or expose raw provider stdout/stderr as receipt evidence.
receipt_binding_contract.binding_rule: Fail closed on missing fields, mismatched ticket/attempt/alias/request/lease/decision/sanitizer/command, expired or consumed lease, provider invocation count outside 0..1, secret-bearing data, raw-output evidence, ambiguous quota unit, nonzero exit presented as success, or invalid normalized WorkResult digest.

stop_conditions: Stop before provider invocation when alias is not exactly agy1 or agy2, AGY_HOME is absent, runtime config is missing, the lease is invalid/expired/consumed/mismatched, sanitizer digest differs, tmux setup fails without recording an allowed safe pre-invocation fallback classification, or any ownership ambiguity exists.
Stop immediately after the first provider invocation outcome for the alias, whether success, timeout, parse failure, nonzero exit, auth prompt, PII/path/token rejection, or ambiguity.
Never retry, use a second provider process, switch accounts, infer a unit, persist raw output, or issue a model task.
Keep quota unknown and require human review on any content-free failure or receipt-binding failure.

agy_executable.check: command -v only; executable was not run

integrity.normalization_method: UTF-8 SHA-256 of compact JSON produced with recursively sorted object keys and separators comma/colon after deleting only integrity.normalized_decision_sha256; arrays retain order and no trailing newline is hashed.
integrity.physical_file_sha256: Reported externally after final write because a file cannot contain its own non-self-referential physical SHA-256. Receipts must bind the externally handed-off exact file digest plus normalized_decision_sha256.

readiness_basis: READY is limited to the exact HITL-gated, account-isolated, one-shot quota observations. JSON syntax, approved policy/config paths, executable presence metadata, tmux version/session metadata, sanitizer digest/syntax/tests, immutable prior hashes, root-medium confirmation, and preflight passed. It is not provider execution proof or dispatch entitlement beyond the unexpired leases.
residual_risk: Quota remains unknown until each fresh sanitized result and bound receipt pass human review. AGY success is validated in-process only and is not portable/offline proof. A lease may expire before admission and must then fail closed without silent renewal.
stop_condition: This decision lane is DONE after final JSON, canonical digest, physical file digest, focused tests, syntax checks, immutable prior hashes, and owned-file diff validation pass. Provider children remain separately gated by their leases and receipt contract.
